title: A11 v1 — Audience Learning Registry (L03 + L06)
owner: Audience Analytics / Learning; Creative advisory consumer
source_decision: Human ChatGPT 2026-10-29: @AI Commerce Engineering Workflow đồng ý triển khai A11 theo Deep Research tiếng Việt.
research_ref: AI_COMMERCE_A11_DEEP_RESEARCH_TIENG_VIET_2026-10-29.md (ChatGPT supplied; research guides design but does not replace live repo contracts)
objective: Implement a deterministic offline-first, evidence-grounded A11 that reads the actual A09 analytics ledger without modification, produces correctly bounded L03 descriptive performance reports/comparisons, and stores versioned, counterevidence-aware L06 learning hypotheses and append-only revisions for Human/Brain/Creative consultation. Never turn observation into causal certainty or creative gate.
scope_in: A11-01: versioned minimal coherent ObservationSnapshot/PerformanceReport/ComparisonResult/LearningHypothesis/LearningEvidence/LearningRecord/LearningRevision contracts (consolidate where justified) and read-only A09 import/observation snapshot adapter; freeze import IDs, observation IDs, metric definitions, source hash, mapping/adapter version, timezone, measurement window, cohort, source verification limits; deterministic snapshot ID and integrity/replay checks.

A11-02/L03: descriptive performance reports with source identity/version/window/denominator; only compute meaningful compatible comparisons; explicit ZERO versus NOT_AVAILABLE/null versus INSUFFICIENT_DATA versus NOT_COMPARABLE; identify sparse/stale/overlap/cohort mismatch/confounders; no causal lift or unsupported cross-provider equivalence; deterministic golden fixture calculations.

A11-03/L06: local independent SQLite learning event/revision ledger and query/read models; hypothesis, creative version, context, observed outcome, supporting and negative/counter-evidence, confounders, status and uncertainty; bound all payloads, preserve exact evidence refs, idempotency and corrections without mutating prior events, integrity verification and robust concurrency/failure handling.

A11-04: offline CLI/Python read/export surfaces for Human/Brain/Creative consultation, stable JSON contracts, deterministic synthetic example/E2E, Windows/Ubuntu tests and evidence report. No automatic A03/A08/A09 writes or creative decisions.

Scope by component and verify-first: respect current EF01-P + MT-01 + EF01-R + EF02 decisions, source pinning, protected-path stop, ordinary out-of-scope verification with scope reconciliation rather than false candidate publication, targeted affected tests plus registered verification on exact candidate.
scope_out: OAuth, direct platform API, scraping, live account entitlement, real metrics verification, public posts/receipts, revenue or conversion attribution.
A10 opportunity ingestion rewrites; A03 content/schema mutations; A08 publishing; creative scoring as mandatory rules; auto-generation, auto-posting, autonomous optimization.
C10/A17 deep Creative Reasoner learn-back integration: future work; A11 merely makes lessons queryable with caveats.
Raw personal data duplication, cross-provider metric equivalence inferred by name, unspecified confidence percentages, causal lift conclusions without experimental design.
Online service, REST dashboard, paid model dependencies, broad refactor of EF01/EF02/AIOS-Renew, automatic merge to main.

design_decisions.evidence_truth: All A09 data sourced via existing contract and USER_SUPPLIED_NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED; synthetic examples are explicitly synthetic. A11 never upgrades provider trust.
design_decisions.reader_boundary: Read existing A09 ledger through public inspect()/raw methods or stable read-only API; never modify A09 schema/ledger; read consistent context-pinned snapshot. Reject hash mismatch, duplicate/invalid/ambiguous references.
design_decisions.metric_comparability: Require explicit compatible platform, metric definition version, unit, denominator, cohort, measurement window/timezone, source and matching policy. A09 NO_CROSS_PROVIDER_EQUIVALENCE remains authoritative.
design_decisions.report_inference: Compute descriptive changes only where inputs permit; meaningful sample/coverage labels and caveats; no statistical significance, causal lift, or viral certainty from observational records.
design_decisions.ledger: A11-owned append-only SQLite with transaction, UPDATE/DELETE protections or equivalent, stable content digests and revisions, deterministic replay; integrity detection is NOT external cryptographic attestation.
design_decisions.consumer: Versioned query/export advisory artifact only; human override and freeform creative preserved.
design_decisions.dependency_DAG: A11-01 -> [A11-02, A11-03] -> A11-04. A11-03 may only reference stable report IDs/contracts from A11-01; no runtime dependence on unfinished A11-02 until fan-in.
design_decisions.security: No provider tokens in test child processes; validate file bounds, JSON duplicate/nonfinite values, malformed IDs/timezones, path traversal/symlinks, no network side effects.

acceptance: AC01 — Reader uses a consistent pinned A09 snapshot; validates schema/hash/provenance and does not write/alter A09 ledger, contracts or A08 linkage.
AC02 — L03 arithmetic and metric meaning are correct for explicit numerator/denominator, unit, timezone, exact [start,end) window and cohort; golden fixtures and non-comparable cases tested.
AC03 — AVAILABLE(0), NOT_AVAILABLE(null), INSUFFICIENT_DATA and NOT_COMPARABLE have separate semantics; missing values never silently coerced to zero.
AC04 — Observational comparisons remain descriptive; no unsupported cross-provider equivalence, causal attribution, guaranteed growth or real provider endorsement.
AC05 — L06 stores hypothesis/creative version/context/source refs/outcome, counterevidence and confounders; contradiction and inconclusive are first-class.
AC06 — Learning ledger is append-only with versioned revisions, idempotent exact replay, integrity/digest checks, correction lineage and rollback after failed transaction.
AC07 — Read/JSON export and CLI preserve stable provenance/uncertainty; never change A03/A08/A09 data or trigger publish/generative actions.

AC08 — Deterministic synthetic offline end-to-end, malformed/corrupt and negative cases; meaningful targeted MT-01 and fan-in Windows/Ubuntu regression results, with actual logs, SHA, diffs and candidate refs. Main merge remains separate.

engineering_execution.model_basis: Human's existing Codex 6.1 Sol Max choice used for A09/A10 and preferred default; actual provider availability determined by live execution.
engineering_execution.source_ref_strategy: Dispatch source_sha must be set to HEAD after this WorkItem commit, not this planning baseline SHA.

verification_result.criterion_scope: AC01-AC08 implemented and regression-verified within offline synthetic/user-supplied scope. A11-03/04 candidates from EF02 #99; exact 68 A11 Git blobs reused on PR #103, no overwrites of post-baseline EF01/EF02 code.
limitations: Offline-first; user-supplied source status is USER_SUPPLIED_NOT_LIVE_VERIFIED
No native provider analytics access, OAuth, public social post, affiliate link entitlement, orders or settled earnings
No demonstrated causal lift; comparability and uncertainty remain explicit
No mandatory Creative Reasoner decision gate or autonomous publishing; A11 is advisory
M4 is not complete: A12, A13 and A14 remain planned
